description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the MRR@10 metric for different DPR configurations. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. There are five lines displayed. The black line, representing “DPR w/o query”, begins at approximately 35.7 at x=1, remains relatively steady at approximately 35.6 between x=2 and x=8, and ends at approximately 35.6 at x=10. The yellow line, representing “DPR w/ gold”, starts at approximately 34.2 at x=1, increases to approximately 36.2 at x=10. The purple line, representing “DPR w/ top-1”, begins at approximately 35.2 at x=1, decreases to approximately 34.8 at x=8, and ends at approximately 34.8 at x=10. The blue line, representing “DPR w/ random”, starts at approximately 35.0 at x=1, decreases to approximately 34.7 at x=8, and ends at approximately 34.7 at x=10. The red line, representing “DPR w/ curriculum”, begins at approximately 35.5 at x=1, remains relatively steady at approximately 35.4 between x=2 and x=10.
